en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own tutoring business and get the same income and tax plan, with the payment costs shown
en.runTitle: Quezon City: moving from a Chinese platform that cut her hours to teaching Japanese and Korean adults, targeting PHP 60,000 a month

fields.label: Adult learner niche and countries
fields.value: Adult learners from Japan and Korea

fields.label: Experience and qualifications
fields.value: TESOL certificate; three years teaching English online for a Chinese platform

fields.label: Household cash requirement
fields.value: At least PHP 60,000 a month from January 2027 (her income target)

fields.label: Available hours
fields.placeholder: e.g. 25 teaching hours a week, evenings and weekends

fields.label: Existing employment, platform contracts and tax registration
fields.value: Teaching online for a Chinese platform that has cut her hours

en.template: Build a practical income plan for my online English teaching business in {city}, serving {niche}, with {experience}, {budget}, {household}, {hours} and {status}. Compare a contract-compatible platform floor with independently acquired direct clients. Show monthly paid lessons, realistic payment costs, operating costs, tax reserves and downside cases. Separate published rates from assumptions, flag unverified eligibility and local requirements, and ask before applying, contacting anyone or creating accounts.

phases.title: Read the platforms' own pages, payment fee tables and Philippine tax rules
phases.note: Platform fees and entry rules, PayPal, Wise and Payoneer costs, freelancer tax options
phases.judgment: It did not accept a flat 5% for payment costs: PayPal's published terms charge 4.40% plus a fixed fee on payments from abroad, so a PHP 1,000 lesson payment already loses 5.9% before currency conversion. The final model uses an 8% allowance instead.

phases.title: Build the guide and a month-by-month income model with every calculation shown
phases.judgment: The plan does not promise the target on time: no source shows PHP 60,000 a month net by January, and the model reaches PHP 60,632 only in April.

phases.title: Independent recomputation of every figure, plus desktop and phone layout checks
phases.judgment: The independent reviewer recomputed all 12 monthly rows and the worked examples (all correct), and made the tax comparison say it is conditional, because whether a percentage-tax deduction applies is still unresolved.

workers: Read the official fee pages for PayPal, Wise and Payoneer in the Philippines and worked out the real cost of getting paid
Compared the platforms that take Filipino tutors for Japanese and Korean learners: fee shares, entry requirements and what is still unconfirmed
Read the Philippine tax authority's rules on freelancer registration, the 8% option versus graduated rates, percentage tax and invoicing
Independently recomputed the income model and checked the tax and payment claims against the source list
